name: Standing Resistance Band Row
steps: Secure a resistance band around a sturdy anchor at chest height.
Hold the band handles with arms extended in front of you, stepping back until there is light tension on the band.
Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly unlocked.
Pull your elbows back past your sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together and keeping your chest proud.
Hold the back contraction for one second, then slowly return your arms forward under control.
coaching_cues: Initiate the pull by pinching your shoulder blades together rather than pulling only with your arms.
Keep your shoulders down and relaxed, avoiding any shrugging.
Maintain an upright, neutral spine without leaning backward.
